reference_form.title: BIMB Securities Trading Account Application Form - Individual

important: Reference catalog prepared from attached form; field IDs are proposed canonical IDs and MUST be mapped to actual DAS repository field IDs/enums. Do not claim current database supports these IDs. No AI accuracy has been verified.

usage.owner_requirement: A fact has both a logical applicant record and an entity role/identifier; do not assign related-person facts to the applicant.
usage.merge_requirement: Never change customer data until staff selects customer, strategy, reviews diff and confirms.
usage.source_requirement: Each populated field must carry document ID, page, evidence reference and observed raw text/mark.

terms_handling.instructions: Store document/terms presence, version, page ranges, clause text/searchability as source evidence. Do not generate permanent customer-profile fields from every printed contractual clause. Do not infer consent to individual terms solely because printed.

layout_note: Page 1 has office-use client/RMR-DLR codes, pages 2-8 also have unlabeled office-use check rectangles beside rows. Preserve visible marks in document evidence, but do not fabricate semantic destination fields for unlabeled boxes.
